name: BMF Bridge
description: Generic socket-backed BMF command/event bridge for Omegga plugins and BMF Desktop event inspection.
author: BMF

runtimeDir.description: Path to Mods/BMF/runtime. If blank, OMEGGA_BMF_RUNTIME_DIR or the standard Omegga-managed BMF runtime path is used.

socketPath.description: Path to Mods/BMF/runtime/socket.json. If blank, runtimeDir/socket.json is used.

preferredTransport.description: Command/event transport. Must remain socket; disconnected sockets are reported as unhealthy.

socketRole.description: Client role sent to the BMF socket broker.

socketSource.description: Source name sent in socket hello, command, and diagnostics envelopes.

maxRecords.description: Maximum normalized records retained in memory for Omegga plugin consumers and BMF Desktop inspection.

commandTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for BMF command responses over the socket bridge.

maxPendingSocketCommands.description: Maximum BMF socket commands awaiting responses. OMEGGA_BMF_BRIDGE_MAX_PENDING_COMMANDS or OMEGGA_BMF_SOCKET_MAX_PENDING_COMMANDS overrides this value.

maxSocketBufferBytes.description: Maximum incomplete or individual newline-delimited socket record size. OMEGGA_BMF_BRIDGE_MAX_BUFFER_BYTES or OMEGGA_BMF_SOCKET_MAX_CLIENT_BUFFER_BYTES overrides this value.

maxSocketCommandBytes.description: Maximum serialized outbound BMF command envelope size. OMEGGA_BMF_BRIDGE_MAX_COMMAND_BYTES or BMF_UNIFIED_SOCKET_MAX_COMMAND_BYTES overrides this value.

socketReconnectMs.description: Delay before reconnecting to the BMF socket broker after a disconnect. Set to 0 to disable reconnects.

statusWriteIntervalMs.description: Interval for writing bmf-bridge-status.json. Set to 0 to write only on status changes.

redactPrivateIpsOnExport.description: Also redact private IPv4 addresses in exported or requested sanitized records.

commands.name: bmfbridge
commands.description: Show BMF bridge socket status and command/event transport health.
